subject.title: [Bug]: [Regression] 2026.5.27: Codex app-server turn-completion stall returns ("Codex stopped before confirming the turn was complete") — regression of #84076 (fixed by #85107)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for unmatched native Codex tool-result and no-final-outcome failures, while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87744 remains scoped to missing turn/completed timeouts?
rationale: The original regression overlaps the narrower timeout tracker, but later reports were explicitly routed here for a distinct no-final-text and unmatched-native-tool lifecycle shape; canonical scope determines the correct recovery boundary and prevents competing fixes.

options.title: Keep Split Canonicals
options.body: Keep this issue for unmatched native tool results and absent terminal outcomes, while retaining https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87744 for missing turn/completed timeout cases.

options.title: Consolidate Under 87744
options.body: Expand https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87744 to cover unmatched native-tool finalization, preserve this issue’s distinct evidence there, and then close this issue as a duplicate.

recommendation.title: Keep Split Canonicals
recommendation.body: Keep this issue for unmatched native tool results and absent terminal outcomes, while retaining https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87744 for missing turn/completed timeout cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex runtime history and involvement with the narrower canonical timeout path make this the best available owner for the tracker-boundary decision.
